title: FormLayout
description: A native form whose fields are laid out on a responsive grid; submit, reset and validation keep their native behaviour.

support.notes: Native view layouts, token-aware Box background/radius/shadow and numeric size resolution, spacing and attached controls, container-measured responsive grids/SplitLayout, sections/actions, compact/expanded/floating AppShell navigation and mobile drawer with route-change dismissal. Native touch/view semantics differ from browser DOM semantics. Native devices do not expose document focus, inert, browser portals or File input APIs; H5 capabilities are specified separately. Device-runtime validation is still required. CSS as/asChild polymorphism is not native. Floating AppShell expands by touch rather than hover. Measurements initially use window width until the native selector query returns. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

translationResources.title: FormLayout
translationResources.description: A native form whose fields are laid out on a responsive grid; submit, reset and validation keep their native behaviour.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: columns follows the form's own width; GridItem fullWidth asChild spans a FormField across the row without a wrapper.

gaps.title: Gaps
gaps.description: gap, rowGap and columnGap accept spacing tokens or CSS values.

FormLayoutProps.columns: Column counts of the inner ResponsiveGrid: a number, or `{ base, sm, md, lg }` (container widths 480 / 768 / 1200px). Integers 1-12
FormLayoutProps.gap: Gap between fields: numbers and numeric strings select spacing tokens, other strings are CSS values

cssVars.--form-layout-max-width: Maximum width of the form (none by default)
cssVars.--form-layout-margin-inline: Inline margin of the form (set auto with a max width to center it)

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Place the layout inside a native <form>: submit, reset and validation stay native. columns="1 2" gives one column on narrow containers and two from 480px; minerva-grid-item full-width spans a row.

gaps.title: Columns and gaps
gaps.description: gap sets both gaps; row-gap and column-gap override them (spacing token numbers or CSS lengths). Works with native fields too.

cssVars.--responsive-grid-align-items: Vertical alignment of the fields in their row (default: stretch).
cssVars.--responsive-grid-justify-items: Horizontal alignment of the fields in their column (default: stretch).
